text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The race ends amid thunderous<n>applause, and
Symboli Rudolf and<n>Maruzensky congratulate one
another on a battle well fought.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Reawakened to the thrill of racing,<n>Symboli Rudolf
pledges to share her<n>joy with every Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Later, at the press conference, she<n>outlines her
dream as Emperor to the<n>world. In this moment,
the Emperor is<n>truly born.
